technical_hard_stop: FAIL — donor crop introduces 12,438 non-manifold edges. Even with stronger visuals this source would not be eligible for final promotion.
decision: DO NOT INTEGRATE UNITY. Source06 keeps Source04 macroarchitecture but changes donor use: close donor crop boundaries, project the relief more strongly within Keep depth, reserve the central portal/banner clear zone, and use a brighter low-frequency relief material. No macro silhouette borrowing, no roof/base donor geometry, zero Tripo.
